newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dongshin wins drug marketing licence.
newsitem.headline: Dongshin wins drug marketing licence.

text.p: Dongshin Pharmaceutical Co said on Friday it has won an exclusive licence to locally market and sell a chickenpox vaccine and a hepatitis-A vaccine manufactured by Smithkline Beecham Korea, a unit of Smithkline Beecham Plc.
Dongshin said in a statement it anticipated total annual sales of about 10 billion won from the two vaccines.
The company said the contract it signed with Smithkline would run for seven years from November 27, 1996.
There will be an opportunity to extend the deal for another three years if desired, then from 2006, the contract will be reviewed on a yearly basis.
Dongshin said it would be responsible for marketing and sales of the chickenpox vaccine, while it will only oversee domestic sales of the other item.
